description: The AGV Tourmodular Street-Tc-2 is engineered for seamless transitions between open-face city stops and full-face highway cruising, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1305g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~87 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Modular Full Face lineup, the agv_tourmodular_street-tc-2 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 track safety.
story:
The AGV Tourmodular Street-Tc-2 represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV Tourmodular Street-Tc-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
